d: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth is faces a political challenge after Republican Congressman Thomas Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment against him. The accusations concern alleged misconduct linked to US military operations in Iran, Venezuela and Yemen, alongside other alleged violations. This has been an ongoing debate as previously he was questioned by Democratic Senator Jon Ossoff over America's military campaign against Iran and claims of a decisive US victory. Ossoff challenged Hegseth to explain why he had declared Iran's military destroyed and combat ineffective, only…
